fact: e-GA states its e-Mrejesho system, on web, app and USSD *152*00#, lets citizens send complaints and comments directly to the relevant institution or ministry and follow them up, anonymously if they choose.
e-GA's director general says e-Mrejesho connects all government institutions, which can exchange the complaints and opinions citizens submit.
The e-Government Authority says the e-Mrejesho system is available by USSD, mobile app and website for citizens to send feedback, complaints or compliments to government institutions.
The e-Government Authority says e-Mrejesho lets citizens reach all government institutions, transfers a misdirected complaint between institutions and allows appeal to a higher level.
